source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
How keywords apply:

- A unit has every keyword of every model in it; a model has only its own.
- A rule for units with a keyword covers any unit where at least 1 model has it.
- A rule for models with a keyword covers only the models that have it.
- A rule for ‘non-X’ models or units applies only to those without keyword X, such as non-**VEHICLE** units.
- A unit of models with different keywords has all of them, so rules for units with any of them affect it; attacks target units, not models.
- Within a mixed unit, a rule for models with a keyword affects only the models that have it.
- Keywords in a comma-separated list, split by slashes or joined by ‘or’ mean any 1 of them, as in an **IMMORTALS**, **DEATHMARKS** or **LYCHGUARD** unit.
- Keywords side by side mean all of them, as in an **AELDARI** **GUARDIANS** unit.
- Older rules that name keywords without saying model or unit, such as **MONSTER**/**VEHICLE** or **TRANSPORT**, mean units with them.
- Singular and plural forms of a keyword work the same.
